tours.minimum-policy-hint: With deferred charge, a departure that has not reached the minimum when its charge deadline passes (30 hours ahead) shows up in Departures for you to decide whether it goes ahead or is cancelled. The terms promise 24 hours of notice, so you can cancel for the minimum until then.
tours.hint-charge-timing: "When the minimum is met" charges as soon as enough people book. "Before departure" charges the number of hours you set, whether the minimum was met or not.
tours.hint-charge-lead-hours: Leave it empty to use the global value ({default} hours). Between {min} and {max} hours.
tours.warn-charge-lead-hours: With fewer than {hours} hours there is little room: the charge deadline passes 30 hours before the departure, and if a card is declined there is hardly any time to retry.
tours.pricing-price-invalid: Enter a valid price: 0 or more.
tours.pricing-hint: Each rate is a base price or a season. Seasons use day and month, without a year: they repeat every year and can span the new year (for example, December 15 to April 30). On a season’s days its price is charged; the rest of the year, the base price. To change a price, edit the amount.
tours.pricing-conflict-base: There is already another active base price for this ticket.
tours.pricing-conflict-season: Shares days with the “{other}” season for this ticket.
tours.schedules-capacity-invalid: Enter a valid capacity: a whole number of 1 or more.

errors.tour_meeting_point_locked: The meeting point cannot change: there are confirmed bookings on upcoming departures. If it must move, cancel those departures or move the bookings to another date first.
errors.tour_cover_image_invalid: The photo must be uploaded from this form.
errors.tour_season_label_required: Each season needs a name (for example, "High").

tours.published-info-hint: The terms and conditions promise that each tour page shows what is not included, the requirements and the child ticket ages, and that this information is binding on the operator. Without it the tour cannot be booked.
tours.hint-child-ages: Required if the tour has a child price. Up to 17 years old.
tours.image-hint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. It is stored in our own storage.

checkout.amount-changed: The amount changed since you started the booking. Start again to see the updated amount.
checkout.your-info-note: We only use your name and email to manage your booking and send you the confirmation and tour notices.
checkout.hold-notice: When you move on to payment, we hold your seats for {minutes} minutes.
checkout.summary-cancellation: Cancellation: if you cancel 24 hours or more in advance we refund 100%; with less than 24 hours, or if you do not show up, there is no refund. checkout.summary-tolerance: Late-arrival tolerance: {minutes} minutes. After that it counts as a no-show.
checkout.sales-not-enabled: Online sales for this tour are not enabled yet.

departures.tray-intro: These departures did not reach the minimum when their charge deadline passed. No money is held: the authorizations were already released. You decide: confirming charges everyone and the departure goes ahead; cancelling cancels it and refunds anything charged. You can cancel for the minimum until 24 hours before the departure; after that, only for another reason. If nobody decides, uncharged bookings are cancelled at departure time.
departures.confirm-ask: Confirm the departure even though it did not reach the minimum? Tourists will be charged within minutes.
departures.cancel-ask: Cancel the departure? Tourists will be notified and anyone who already paid gets a 100% refund.
departures.decision-error: The decision could not be applied. Reload the page and try again.
departures.decision-already-resolved: Somebody else already resolved this departure. Reload the page.
departures.decision-capture-in-progress: A charge is in progress on this departure. Try again in a few minutes.
departures.decision-minimum-too-late: Less than 24 hours to go: it can no longer be cancelled for the minimum. Confirm it, or cancel it from the departure choosing another reason (100% refund).

settings.field-charge-lead-hours: Default charge lead time (hours before departure)
settings.hint-charge-lead-hours: How many hours before the departure tourists are charged, for tours that charge "before the departure" and do not set their own lead time. The charge deadline passes 30 hours before the departure, so the minimum is {min}. Between {min} and {max} hours.

errors.settings_unauthorized: Only an administrator can change settings.

settings.operator-intro: These details appear in the terms and conditions, the privacy notice, the site and email footers, and the summary before paying. Online sales are enabled once every field is filled in, except the ICT declaration, which is optional. Every change is logged.
settings.hint-operator_legal_name: As registered, for example "Boka Verde Tours S.A."
settings.hint-operator_brand: The name tourists know the business by.
settings.hint-operator_contact_email: Receives questions, date change requests and complaints. The terms promise an answer to complaints within 10 business days.
settings.hint-operator_privacy_email: Receives requests to access, correct or delete data, answered within 5 business days. It can be the same as the questions email.
settings.hint-operator_hours: Shown after the phone number, for example "Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.".
settings.hint-operator_ict_declaration: The number, if the business has one. Leave it empty if not: the sentence does not appear in the terms.
settings.field-operator_has_liability_policy: We hold a current civil liability insurance policy
settings.hint-no-show-tolerance: After these minutes, anyone who has not arrived counts as a no-show and gets no refund. It appears in the purchase summary and in the confirmation email; each booking keeps the value in force when it was made. Between {min} and {max} minutes.
settings.hint-booking-cutoff: Online bookings for each departure close this many hours before it starts. With 0, bookings are open until departure time. Between {min} and {max} hours.

operations.reason-hint-refund: Each paid booking gets 100% back right away and the tourist receives a notice with the amount.
operations.reason-hint-review: No automatic refund: each paid booking goes to review and the tourist is told we will write with our decision.
operations.reason-minimum-too-late: With 24 hours or less a departure is no longer cancelled for the minimum. Choose another reason, which refunds 100%.
operations.minimum-tray-intro: A departure that does not reach the minimum is cancelled automatically one day before, with a 100% refund and a notice to the tourist. Until then you can keep it or cancel it.
operations.minimum-seats: {seats} of {minimum} minimum seats · resolves automatically on {cutoff}
operations.keep-ask: Keep this departure even if it does not reach the minimum? It will no longer be cancelled automatically.
operations.review-tray-intro: Departures cancelled because of the weather or for safety. Decide each booking from its detail: the tourist is waiting for an answer.
operations.refund-tray-intro: Refunds that failed, are waiting for a transfer or have not moved for more than a day. Resolve each one from the booking detail: the customer is waiting for their money.
operations.review-intro: The departure was cancelled for {reason}. Decide what happens to this booking; the tourist receives an email with the decision.
operations.review-no-refund-ask: Close this booking without a refund? The tourist receives a cancellation notice with no refund.
operations.review-reschedule-hint: You can also move it to another date at no cost with "Change date".
operations.reschedule-ask: Move the booking to this departure? Nothing is charged or refunded and the tourist receives the new date.
operations.reschedule-empty: There are no other upcoming departures of this tour.
operations.transfer-request-ask: Ask the tourist for account details to refund by bank transfer or SINPE Móvil?
operations.transfer-awaiting: Waiting for the tourist details. Once you make the transfer, record it here.
operations.error-operation_unauthorized: You are not allowed to do this.
operations.error-operation_invalid: Check the details and try again.
operations.error-operation_already_done: Someone else already resolved this. Reload the page.
operations.error-operation_minimum_too_late: With 24 hours or less a departure is no longer cancelled for the minimum. Choose another reason.

operations.error-operation_not_under_review: This booking is no longer under review. Reload the page.
operations.error-operation_no_capacity: The chosen departure does not have enough seats.

operations.error-operation_not_reschedulable: This booking can no longer change date.
operations.error-operation_provider_may_settle: OnvoPay may still credit this refund to the card: check its dashboard before transferring.
operations.reason-minimum-resolved: This departure is already resolved for the minimum (kept or reached). Choose another reason.
operations.error-operation_other_refund_active: This booking has another refund in progress. Check it before transferring.
operations.transfer-amount-hint: In dollars, exactly the refunded amount ({amount}). In colones, what you transferred at the day's exchange rate.

privacy.page-intro: When someone asks to erase their data, look them up by email. Paid bookings are anonymized: the sale record is kept without data that identifies them, as the privacy notice says. Bookings that were never paid are deleted. You have 5 business days to answer. To correct a name or an email, use the booking detail.
privacy.preview-empty: There are no bookings with that email. There is nothing to erase.
privacy.preview-total: There {total, plural, one {is # booking} other {are # bookings}} with that email:
privacy.preview-what-happens: Erasing anonymizes paid or refunded bookings and deletes the ones never paid. It cannot be undone.
privacy.preview-upcoming: {count, plural, one {One booking is} other {# bookings are}} for tours that have not happened yet: they are anonymized anyway and the person stops receiving notices.
privacy.preview-pending-refund: There is money pending to be returned to this person. Finish the refund before erasing their data, or they would lose the notice about their money.
privacy.erase-ask: Erase the data of {email}? This cannot be undone.
privacy.erase-done: Done: {anonymized, plural, one {# booking anonymized} other {# bookings anonymized}} and {deleted, plural, one {# deleted} other {# deleted}}. It was logged.
privacy.erase-retained: {count, plural, one {# booking was not erased because it has a charge or a departure in progress} other {# bookings were not erased because they have a charge or a departure in progress}}. Run the erasure again once they finish.
privacy.error-unauthorized: Only an administrator can do this.
privacy.error-pending-refund: There is an unfinished refund: nothing was erased.
privacy.contact-saved: Details corrected. Pending notices go to the new email.
privacy.contact-error-unauthorized: Only an administrator can correct these details.
privacy.contact-error-invalid: Check the name and the email.
privacy.contact-error-not-found: This booking no longer has data to correct.
